purpose: Sanitized interruption receipt and planned continuation scope; not a new registration or launch approval.

interruption.error: GateError: Port 8133 unavailable; will not replace another service
interruption.stage: port availability guard before server Popen, harness dispatch, or model request

retained_smoke.success_outcomes_omitted: Smoke success is not the continuation gate; validated identities/tool coverage are retained.

port_diagnosis.inference_about_parent: Clean shutdown followed immediately by a plain bind availability probe is consistent with TIME_WAIT causing a false unavailable-port decision. No contemporaneous errno/socket table was retained at the original failure.
port_diagnosis.actual_port_after_interruption: A later read-only lsof/netstat sample found no matching listener or connection rows; this is not a socket table from the failure instant.

independent_micro_experiment.scope: Only sockets owned by the diagnostic process on a new random loopback port; no access to the experiment service port.

port_diagnosis.confidence_boundary: The independent reproduction establishes the mechanism, not direct observation of TIME_WAIT at the parent service port; a transient competing owner is not retrospectively disproven.

continuation_scope.execution_change: Launcher port availability detection only; continuation scheduling excludes the three validated smoke positions.

privacy: No local paths, process identifiers, hostnames, secrets, model replies, or conversation text are included.
